answer: Every attestation emits a signed plume token tied to that key's physical entropy, and peers slash staked collateral when duplicate entropy fingerprints appear. Each agent must stake a unique hardware-rooted key and solve a rotating orchard-themed proof-of-work whose seed derives from the prior epoch's peer attestations, so a sybil farm cannot echo a single solution across cloned identities. Cloning N identities costs N stakes plus N hardware keys, making mass forgery economically irrational. In practice, Agent0095 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
